finalText:
**Redis died and took the service down.**

At 02:14:07 the cache host `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections. Every read went straight to the store. Requests piled past the 500 limit. At 02:31:44 `worker-2` ran out of memory. Seven seconds later the supervisor killed the API.

Redis never came back. 13 retries, all refused.

This log is dated July 4, not last night.
